program differ_by_1_bit
  implicit none
  integer :: n, a, b, i, m, p(0:131071) = 0
  read(*,*) n, a, b
  if (mod(popcnt(a),2) == mod(popcnt(b),2)) then
    write(*,'(a)') "NO"
    stop
  end if
  m = lshift(1,n)-1
  p(0:m) = compose(n,a,b)
  write(*,'(a)') "YES"
  write(*,'(i0)',advance='no') p(0)
  do i = 1, m
    write(*,'(x,i0)',advance='no') p(i)
  end do
  write(*,*)
  stop
contains
  recursive function compose(n,a,b) result(p)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: n, a, b
    integer :: s, t, x = 0, y = 0, c = 0, i, j, k
    integer :: p(0:lshift(1,n)-1), q(0:lshift(1,n-1)-1), r(0:lshift(1,n-1)-1)
    p = 0
    if (n == 1) then
      p(0:1) = (/a,b/)
      return
    end if
    s = lshift(1,n-1)-1
    t = lshift(1,n)-1
    do i = 0, n-1
      if (btest(a,i) .eqv. btest(b,i)) cycle
      do j = 0, i-1
        if (btest(a,j)) x = ibset(x,j)
        if (btest(b,j)) y = ibset(y,j)
      end do
      k = i
      do j = i+1, n-1
        if (btest(a,j)) x = ibset(x,j-1)
        if (btest(b,j)) y = ibset(y,j-1)
      end do
      c = ibset(x,0)
      if (btest(x,0)) c = ibclr(x,0)
      exit
    end do
    q = compose(n-1,x,c)
    r = compose(n-1,c,y)
    do i = 0, s
      do j = 0, k-1
        if (btest(q(i),j)) p(i) = ibset(p(i),j)
        if (btest(r(i),j)) p(i+s+1) = ibset(p(i+s+1),j)
      end do
      if (btest(a,k)) p(i) = ibset(p(i),k)
      if (btest(b,k)) p(i+s+1) = ibset(p(i+s+1),k)
      do j = k+1, n-1
        if (btest(q(i),j-1)) p(i) = ibset(p(i),j)
        if (btest(r(i),j-1)) p(i+s+1) = ibset(p(i+s+1),j)
      end do
    end do
    return
  end function compose
end program differ_by_1_bit

findSeq :: Int -> Int -> Int -> [Int] -> [Int]
findSeq !from !to !bitMask
  | popCount bitMask <= 1 = (from:) . (to:)
  | otherwise = findSeq from0 to0 bitMask1 . findSeq from1 to1 bitMask1
  where
    !undone = from `xor` to
    !undone_least = undone .&. (-undone)
    !bitMask1 = bitMask `xor` undone_least
    !bitMask1_least = bitMask1 .&. (-bitMask1)
    !from0 = from
    !to0 = from `xor` bitMask1_least
    !from1 = from `xor` bitMask1_least `xor` undone_least
    !to1 = to

-- PREREQUISTE: 0 <= from,to < 2^n
findSeq :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Maybe [Int]
{-# INLINE findSeq #-}
findSeq !n !a !b
  | even $ popCount $ xor a b, n > 0 = Nothing
  | otherwise  = Just $ build
                 $ \cns nil -> builder cns a b (xor a b) (bit n - 1) nil
  where
    builder :: (Int -> b -> b) -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> b -> b
    {-# INLINE builder #-}
    builder c = go
      where
        go !from !to !xorft !bitMask
          | bitMask == 0 = c from
          | otherwise    = go1 from mid0 newMask_least newMask
                           . go mid1 to (xor mid1 to) newMask
          where
            !xorft_least = xorft .&. (-xorft)
            !newMask = bitMask .&. complement xorft_least
            !newMask_least = newMask .&. (-newMask)
            !mid0 = from `xor` newMask_least
            !mid1 = mid0 `xor` xorft_least
        go1 !from !to !xorft_uniq !bitMask
          | bitMask == 0 = c from
          | otherwise    = go1 from mid0 newMask_least newMask
                           . go1 mid1 to newMask_least newMask
          where
            !newMask = bitMask .&. complement xorft_uniq
            !newMask_least = newMask .&. (-newMask)
            !mid0 = from `xor` newMask_least
            !mid1 = to   `xor` newMask_least

path1 :: Int -> Int -> Int -> [Int] -> V.Vector Int

-- path1 n a b xs | not (popCount (a `xor` b) == 1) = error "path1: precondition 2"
path1 1 a b [] = V.fromList [a,b] -- [0,2^k] popCount (a `xor` b) == 1

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Maybe [Int]
solve n a b | even (popCount (xor a b)) = Nothing
            | otherwise = Just (subsolve n n (2^n - 1) a b)

subsolve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> [Int]
subsolve n 1 mask a b = [a, b]
subsolve n k mask a b = part1 ++ part2
  where
  t = (xor a b) .&. mask
  lsb = t .&. (-t)
  newMask = xor mask lsb
  inNewMask = newMask .&. (-newMask)
  c = xor a inNewMask
  part1 = subsolve n (k-1) newMask a c
  part2 = subsolve n (k-1) newMask (xor c lsb) b

-- PREREQUISTE: 0 <= from,to < 2^n
findSeq :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Maybe [Int]
{-# INLINE findSeq #-}
findSeq !n !a !b
  | even $ popCount $ xor a b, n > 0 = Nothing
  | otherwise  = Just $ build
                 $ \cns nil -> builder cns a b (xor a b) (bit n - 1) nil
  where
    builder :: (Int -> b -> b) -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> b -> b
    {-# INLINE builder #-}
    builder c = go
      where
        go !from !to !xorft !bitMask
          | bitMask == 0 = c from
          | otherwise    = go from mid0 newMask_least newMask
                           . go mid1 to (xor mid1 to) newMask
          where
            !xorft_least = xorft .&. (-xorft)
            !newMask = bitMask .&. complement xorft_least
            !newMask_least = newMask .&. (-newMask)
            !mid0 = from `xor` newMask_least
            !mid1 = mid0 `xor` xorft_least

-- path1 n a b xs
--   n == length xs + 1
--   popCount (a `xor` b) == 1
path1 :: Int -> Int -> Int -> [Int] -> V.Vector Int
path1 n a b xs | not (n == length xs + 1) = error "path1: precondition 1"
path1 n a b xs | not (popCount (a `xor` b) == 1) = error "path1: precondition 2"
path1 1 a b [] = V.fromList [a,b] -- [0,2^k] popCount (a `xor` b) == 1
path1 n a b (k:ks) = let v = path1 (n - 1) a b ks
                         (v0,v1) = V.splitAt (2^(n-2)) v
                         y = 2^k
                     in v0 <> V.map (`xor` y) (V.reverse v0) <> V.map (`xor` y) (V.reverse v1) <> v1

-- pathN m a b xs availBits
--   m == length xs + length availBits + 1
pathN :: Int -> Int -> Int -> [Int] -> [Int] -> V.Vector Int

                                       b' = a' `xor` bit i1
                                   in path1 (m-1) a a' (is ++ availBits) <> pathN (m-1) b' b is (i0 : availBits)

def to_bit_array(num)
  result = []
  while num > 0
    result.push(num % 2)
    num = num / 2
  end
  result
end

def array_diff(a, b)
  a.zip(b).map { |ab| ab[0] - ab[1] }
end

def to_int(bit)
  bit.map.with_index { |b, i| b * (2 ** i) }.inject(&:+)

        end

    p = 0

    end

        q |= 1<<i
    end
    c = ((a&p)|((a&q)>>1))

    y = a[x]

        v[i] = (v[i]&p)|((v[i]&q)<<1)|((y^1)<<x)
    end
    return u+v
end

def trace(bits, idx, history):
  if idx == len(bits):
    history.append(bits[:])
  elif idx == len(bits) - 1:
    history.append(bits[:])
    bits[idx] = 1 - bits[idx]
    history.append(bits[:])
  else:
    trace(bits, idx + 1, history)
    bits[idx] = 1 - bits[idx]
    trace(bits, idx + 1, history)


def down(bits, idx, count, history):
  if idx == len(bits):
    history.append(bits[:])
  elif idx == len(bits) - 1:
    history.append(bits[:])
    bits[idx] = 1 - bits[idx]
    history.append(bits[:])
  elif count > 0:
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx] = 1 - bits[idx]
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx + 1] = 1 - bits[idx + 1]
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx] = 1 - bits[idx]
    down(bits, idx + 2, count - 2, history)
  else:
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx + 1] = 1 - bits[idx + 1]
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx ] = 1 - bits[idx ]
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx + 1] = 1 - bits[idx + 1]
    down(bits, idx + 2, count - 2, history)

  remain = 0
  mapper = [-1] * n

  for i in range(n):
    if (x >> i) & 0x1 != 0:
      mapper[count] = i
      count += 1
    else:
      remain += 1
      mapper[-remain] = i

  if count % 2 == 0:
    print('NO', flush=True)
    return

  bits = [0] * n
  history = []
  trace(bits, 1, history)
  bits[0] = 1
  down(bits, 1, count - 1, history)

  for i in range(len(history)):
    v = history[i][:]

    for j, m in enumerate(mapper):
      history[i][n - m - 1] = v[j]

  history = [str(a ^ int(''.join(str(v) for v in h), 2)) for h in history]

  print(' '.join(history), flush=True)

def walk(a, b, rest_bit):
    ret = []
    if rest_bit == 0:
        return [a,b]

    change_bit = 0
    for i in range(19,-1,-1):
        if (rest_bit & (1 << i)) != 0:
            change_bit = 1 << i
            break
    rest_bit &= ~change_bit
    ret += walk(a, a ^ change_bit, rest_bit)
    ret += walk(b ^ change_bit, b, rest_bit)
    return ret

def solve():

    change_bit = (A ^ B)
    if bin(change_bit).count('1') != 1:
        print('NO')
        return
    rest_bit = (1<<N)-1
    rest_bit &= ~change_bit
    print('YES')
    print(' '.join(map(str,walk(A,B,rest_bit))))

def split(n, a, b, remain, ai, ans, width):
    # print(n, a, b, remain, ai, ans, width)
    # print(*(f'{c:5d}' for c in ans))
    # print(*(f'{c:05b}' for c in ans))
    if width == 2:
        ans[ai] = a
        ans[ai + 1] = b
        return
    x = a ^ b
    y = x & -x  # Rightmost Bit at which is different for a and b
    l = y.bit_length() - 1
    remain.remove(l)
    i = next(iter(remain))
    lb = a ^ (1 << i)
    ra = lb ^ y
    width >>= 1
    split(n, a, a ^ (1 << i), remain, ai, ans, width)
    split(n, ra, b, remain, ai + width, ans, width)
    remain.add(l)

def remove_bit(num, i):
    new_num = (num >> i + 1) << i
    new_num += num & ((1 << i) - 1)
    return new_num

def insert_bit(num1, num2, i):
    new_num = (num1 << 1) & ~(-1 + (1 << i + 1))
    new_num += num1 & (-1 + (1 << i + 1))
    new_num += num2 & (1 << i)
    return new_num

def solve(N, A, B):
    if N == 1:
        return [A, B]

    for i in range(N):
        if A >> i & 1 != B >> i & 1:
            r_bit = i
            break

    AA = remove_bit(A, r_bit)
    BB = remove_bit(B, r_bit)

    for i in range(N - 1):
        if (AA & 1 << i) == (BB & 1 << i):
            CC = AA & (-1 - (1 << i)) + (~AA & (1 << i))
            break
    A_list = solve(N - 1, AA, CC)
    B_list = solve(N - 1, CC, BB)

    A_list = list(map(lambda x: insert_bit(x, A, r_bit), A_list))
    B_list = list(map(lambda x: insert_bit(x, B, r_bit), B_list))

    return A_list + B_list

    ret = []
    if rest_bit == 0:

def s_permutations(seq):
    items = [[]]
    for j in seq:
        new_items = []
        for i, item in enumerate(items):
            if i % 2:
                # step up
                new_items += [item[:i] + [j] + item[i:] for i in range(len(item) + 1)]
            else:
                # step down
                new_items += [item[:i] + [j] + item[i:] for i in range(len(item), -1, -1)]

def num_of_1bit(n: int)->int:
    '''n の立っているビットを数えます。
    :param n: number
    :return: number of 1 bit
    '''
    s = 0
    while n > 0:
        s += n & 1
        n >>= 1
    return s


def diff_idx(a: int, b: int)->int:
    '''a と b のビット列を比較してビットの状態が異なる最小の
    インデックスを返します。ここで、インデックスは 2^i の i 
    に対応する。
    :param a: number 1
    :param b: number 2
    :return: index
    '''
    if a == b:
        return -1
    idx = 0
    while a > 0 or b > 0:
        if a & 1 != b & 1:
            break
        idx += 1
        a, b = a >> 1, b >> 1
    return idx


def remove_bit(n: int, idx: int)->int:
    '''n の idx 番目のビットを消去します。idx は 2^idx に対
    応します。
    ex) n = 1011011, idx = 2
    -> 101111

    :param n: number
    :param idx: index
    :return: number removed `idx`th bit
    '''
    upper = (n >> (idx+1)) << idx
    lower = n & ((1 << idx) - 1)
    return upper | lower


def insert_bit(n: int, idx: int, bit: bool)->int:
    '''n の idx 番目にビットを挿入します。
    ex) n = 101111, idx = 2, bit = True
    -> 1011111
    '''
    upper = (n >> idx) << (idx + 1)
    lower = n & ((1 << idx) - 1)
    insert = bit << idx
    return upper | insert | lower


def route(_from: int, to: int, N: int)->list:
    '''_from から to に至る N ビットの数を全て使ったルートを
    計算します。
    :param _from: start
    :param to: end
    :param N: number of bit
    :return: routes
    '''
    if N == 1:
        return [_from, to]

    di = diff_idx(_from, to)

    a = remove_bit(_from, di)
    b = remove_bit(to, di)
    c = a ^ 1

    from_bit = (_from & (1 << di)) != 0
    to_bit = (to & (1 << di)) != 0

    first_half = map(lambda x: insert_bit(x, di, from_bit), route(a, c, N-1))
    second_half = map(lambda x: insert_bit(x, di, to_bit),  route(c, b, N-1))

    return list(first_half) + list(second_half)


def diff_by_1_bit(N: int, A: int, B: int)->list:
    num_A = num_of_1bit(A)
    num_B = num_of_1bit(B)
    if abs(num_A - num_B) % 2 == 0:
        return []

    return route(A, B, N)

def main():
    def parity_onebit(x):
        return bin(x).count("1") & 1

    def make_route(s, g, state):
        if state.count(-1) == 1:
            return [s, g]
        sep_dig = bin(s ^ g)[::-1].find("1")
        s_bit = (s >> sep_dig) & 1
        Lstate = state[:]
        Rstate = state[:]
        Lstate[sep_dig] = s_bit
        Rstate[sep_dig] = 1 - s_bit
        for i in range(16):
            ng = 0
            i_copy = i
            for sk in Lstate[::-1]:
                ng <<= 1
                if sk == -1:
                    ng += i_copy & 1
                    i_copy >>= 1
                else:
                    ng += sk
            ns = ng ^ (1 << sep_dig)
            if ng != s and parity_onebit(ng) != parity_onebit(s) and ns != g:
                break
        res = make_route(s, ng, Lstate)
        state[sep_dig] = 1 - s_bit
        res += make_route(ns, g, Rstate)
        return res

        exit()

                break
        a2 = (a & (2**i-1))+((a >> (i+1)) << i)

def solve(n, a, b):
    if n <= 0:
        return []
    if bitcount(a ^ b) % 2 == 0:
        return []
    if n == 1:

    # 奇数
    # 違うbitを1つ取り除く
    mask = 1

    na = a // (mask << 1) + a % mask

    mid = na ^ 1

from collections import defaultdict
from itertools import product, cycle, chain

def Gray_code(N):
    for i in range(2**N):
        yield format(i^(i>>1), "0>"+str(N)+"b")

def code(N):
    L0 = ["10", "00", "01", "11"]
    if N == 0:
        return ["",]
    elif N == 2:
        return L0
    else:
        L1 = list(Gray_code(2))
        L2 = code(N-2)
        L = ["".join(l) for L_ in zip([[l] for l in L2], chain([L1,],cycle([L0, L0[::-1]]))) for l in product(*L_)]
        return L

def solve():
    N, A, B = map(int, input().split())
    C = A^B
    d = 0
    D = []
    E = []
    b = 0
    while b < N:
        if C&1:
            d += 1
            D.append(b)
        else:
            E.append(b)
        b += 1
        C >>= 1

    if d % 2 == 0:
        res = "NO"
        return res 
    else:
        X = D[:1]+E
        Y = D[1:]
        Z = list(Gray_code(len(X)))
        W = code(len(Y))
        L = ["".join(l) for L_ in zip([[l] for l in Z], chain([list(Gray_code(len(Y))),],cycle([W, W[::-1]]))) for l in product(*L_)]
        #print(X,Y,D,E)
        #print(L)
        res = "YES\n" + " ".join(str((A&B)^sum(int(b)*2**n for n,b in zip(X+Y, l))) for l in L)

        return str(res)

def num_of_1bit(n: int)->int:
    '''n の立っているビットを数えます。
    :param n: number
    :return: number of 1 bit
    '''
    s = 0
    while n > 0:
        s += n & 1
        n >>= 1
    return s


def diff_idx(a: int, b: int)->int:
    '''a と b のビット列を比較してビットの状態が異なる最小の
    インデックスを返します。ここで、インデックスは 2^i の i 
    に対応する。
    :param a: number 1
    :param b: number 2
    :return: index
    '''
    if a == b:
        return -1
    idx = 0
    while a > 0 or b > 0:
        if a & 1 != b & 1:
            break
        idx += 1
        a, b = a >> 1, b >> 1
    return idx


def remove_bit(n: int, idx: int)->int:
    '''n の idx 番目のビットを消去します。idx は 2^idx に対
    応します。
    ex) n = 1011011, idx = 2
    -> 101111

    :param n: number
    :param idx: index
    :return: number removed `idx`th bit
    '''
    upper = (n >> (idx+1)) << idx
    lower = n & ((1 << idx) - 1)
    return upper | lower


def insert_bit(n: int, idx: int, bit: bool)->int:
    '''n の idx 番目にビットを挿入します。
    ex) n = 101111, idx = 2, bit = True
    -> 1011111
    '''
    upper = (n >> idx) << (idx + 1)
    lower = n & ((1 << idx) - 1)
    insert = bit << idx
    return upper | insert | lower


def route(_from: int, to: int, N: int)->list:
    '''_from から to に至る N ビットの数を全て使ったルートを
    計算します。
    :param _from: start
    :param to: end
    :param N: number of bit
    :return: routes
    '''
    if N == 1:
        return [_from, to]

    di = diff_idx(_from, to)

    a = remove_bit(_from, di)
    b = remove_bit(to, di)
    c = a ^ 1

    from_bit = (_from & (1 << di)) != 0
    to_bit = (to & (1 << di)) != 0

    first_half = map(lambda x: insert_bit(x, di, from_bit), route(a, c, N-1))
    second_half = map(lambda x: insert_bit(x, di, to_bit),  route(c, b, N-1))

    return list(first_half) + list(second_half)


def diff_by_1_bit(N: int, A: int, B: int)->list:
    num_A = num_of_1bit(A)
    num_B = num_of_1bit(B)
    if abs(num_A - num_B) % 2 == 0:
        return []

    return route(A, B, N)

def solve(n, a, b):
    if n <= 0:
        return []
    if bitcount(a ^ b) % 2 == 0:
        return []
    if n == 1:
        return [a, b]
    # 奇数
    # 違うbitを1つ取り除く
    mask = 1
    while (a ^ b) & mask == 0:
        mask <<= 1
    na = a // (mask << 1) * mask + a % mask
    nb = b // (mask << 1) * mask + b % mask
    mid = na ^ 1
    ret = []
    for r in solve(n - 1, na, mid):
        ret.append((r // mask * mask << 1) + (a & mask) + r % mask)
    for r in solve(n - 1, mid, nb):
        ret.append((r // mask * mask << 1) + (b & mask) + r % mask)
    return ret

    if l is None:

def grayCode(n):
    """nビットGrayコードの生成器"""
    for v in range(2 ** n):
        yield v ^ (v >> 1)

def grayCodeEnding(b, n):
    """0で始まりbで終わるnビットGrayコードの生成器"""
    code = list(grayCode(n))
    l = len(code)
    p = code.index(b)  # bの出現位置
    assert p % 2 == 1  # bの重みは奇数なので奇数番目に現れる

    # 両端から交互にyield
    q = 0
    while q != p:
        yield code[q]
        if q % 2 == 0:
            q = l - 1 - q
        else:
            q += 1 if q < p else -1

    # 残りを線形にyield
    q = l - 1 - q
    d = 1 if q < p else -1
    for i in range(q + d, p + d, d):
        yield code[i]

    """vをNビット2進表記したときの1の個数"""
    return sum(1 for k in range(N) if (v & (1 << k)) != 0)

def trace(bits, idx, history):
  if idx == len(bits):
    history.append(bits[:])
  elif idx == len(bits) - 1:
    history.append(bits[:])
    bits[idx] = 1 - bits[idx]
    history.append(bits[:])
  else:
    trace(bits, idx + 1, history)
    bits[idx] = 1 - bits[idx]
    trace(bits, idx + 1, history)


def down(bits, idx, count, history):
  if idx == len(bits):
    history.append(bits[:])
  elif idx == len(bits) - 1:
    history.append(bits[:])
    bits[idx] = 1 - bits[idx]
    history.append(bits[:])
  elif count > 0:
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx] = 1 - bits[idx]
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx + 1] = 1 - bits[idx + 1]
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx] = 1 - bits[idx]
    down(bits, idx + 2, count - 2, history)
  else:
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx + 1] = 1 - bits[idx + 1]
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx ] = 1 - bits[idx ]
    trace(bits, idx + 2, history)
    bits[idx + 1] = 1 - bits[idx + 1]
    down(bits, idx + 2, count - 2, history)

  print(' '.join(history), flush=True)

import sys

def revBit(Ai):
    return '1' if Ai == '0' else '0'

def rec(binA, binB):
    if len(binA) == 1:
        return [binA, binB]

    for i, (Ai, Bi) in enumerate(zip(binA, binB)):
        if Ai != Bi:
            x = i
            Ax, Bx = Ai, Bi
            break

    binA2 = binA[:x] + binA[x+1:]
    binB2 = binB[:x] + binB[x+1:]
    binC = binA2[:-1] + revBit(binA2[-1])

    ptn1s = rec(binA2, binC)
    ptn2s = rec(binC, binB2)

    ptns = []
    for ptn1 in ptn1s:
        ptns.append(ptn1[:x] + Ax + ptn1[x:])
    for ptn2 in ptn2s:
        ptns.append(ptn2[:x] + Bx + ptn2[x:])

    return ptns


N, A, B = map(int, input().split())

binA, binB = bin(A)[2:].zfill(N), bin(B)[2:].zfill(N)
numDiff = sum([Ai != Bi for Ai, Bi in zip(binA, binB)])

if numDiff % 2 == 0:
    print('NO')
    sys.exit()

ptns = rec(binA, binB)
print('YES')
print(' '.join([str(int(ptn, 2)) for ptn in ptns]))
